sidecar_purpose: Repo-resident template sidecar for a three-hero, six-alternative character asset sheet. Supports character template selection, layout planning, and QA of character sheets with a hero row and an alt row.
source_truth_note: This sidecar is derived visual evidence for the referenced image. The repo image bytes and package manifest remain authoritative for custody; this sidecar does not authorize derivative images or broaden canon.
runtime_use_note: Use this sidecar to understand the template layout, intended use, and constraints. Inspect the image pixels directly for exact panel labels, dimensions, and spacing.
do_not_infer_note: Do not infer additional hero slots, alternate counts, or final canon status beyond the observed three-hero-six-alt candidate template.

summary: Candidate template for a three-hero, six-alternative character/asset sheet. The top row contains three equal hero panels, and the bottom row contains six smaller alternative panels arranged in two rows of three. A header and footer provide metadata and continuity notes.

composition: Landscape template with dark green border and cream/white field.
Header reads 'ASSET SHEET' with TITLE, TYPE, STATUS, VERSION, SOURCE/QA columns.
Metadata: TITLE '3 Hero 6 Alt', TYPE 'Character / asset sheet', STATUS 'candidate', VERSION 'v4', SOURCE/QA 'GPT-authored template'.
Top row: three equal hero panels labelled HERO 1, HERO 2, HERO 3.
Bottom area: six alt panels arranged in two rows of three, labelled ALT 1 through ALT 6.
guidance_notes: Use for a character or asset family that needs three primary hero views and six smaller alternative variants.
Good for expression sets, pose variants, prop alternatives, or minor style tests.

positive_constraints: Use this template for three-hero, six-alt character or asset families.
Keep the hero row for primary views and the alt grid for variants.
Maintain the metadata header and footer notes.
negative_constraints: Do not treat 'candidate' status as final accepted canon.
Do not add extra hero or alt slots beyond the prescribed layout.
Do not use for multi-location or non-character assets without layout review.

best_for: Planning 3-hero, 6-alt character or prop reference sheets.
QA of sheets built from this template.
not_sufficient_for: Final canon approval without sheet content and image QA.
Exact measurements; inspect the image pixels.
